title: Skateboard · archive operation

source.why_this_clip: The camera follows a rider rolling away on the board; continuous between view changes at 2.5 s and 4.75 s.

source_selection.evidence: Sixteen raw-source samples visually inspected in preflight/source-design-sheet.jpg; final source-contact-sheet.jpg additionally spans refined clock interval. No cut/dissolve in selected event.

vector_observation_clock.method: Estimated local pixel appearance correspondence between frozen SAM JPEGs and retained raw frames; grayscale96x72RMSE<=2 andrunnerupgap>=.25. Ambiguous samples use clock interpolation between accepted anchors, or nominal12fps extrapolation at ends.

drawn by agent from four matched raw-source observations: cropped shirt, trouser contour, near arm and two shoes. Not a Quick, Draw! character; no head added outside crop. Lower-leg/shoe contours are retargeted below the source-observed waist to the stylized native deck so the rider operates the board; this is not an independently tracked material contact.

assembly_summary: The original four-stroke skateboard rolls past a growing cone under its source-observed rider. Camera/background projection and the board remain separate; rider context is agent-drawn and not a native doodle.
review_note: Review candidate. Independent still critique and normal-speed playback approval pending. No training ran.
